Name: Arm Holdings plc American Depositary Shares
Description: Arm Holdings plc is a leading technology company that specializes in the design and licensing of central processing unit (CPU) architecture and related technologies, which are essential for semiconductor companies and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in developing a wide range of electronic products. As a pivotal player in the semiconductor ecosystem, Arm's intellectual property fuels advancements in artificial intelligence, IoT, and automotive tech, positioning the company for significant growth in an increasingly connected world.
